title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!! — Episode1 One Week to Go

meta.Event Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, have you guys heard the news?!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: What news...? Oh, are you talking about their event?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Of course we heard!
Everyone around here's been asking about it!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Next week at COL, right?
I can't wait to see what it's like...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
I wonder how their event's going to go.
Rumor has it that An and the others are training pretty hard for it...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Surpassing RAD WEEKEND won't be easy... But after seeing An and Kohane battle that time... They proved themselves as incredible singers, so maybe, just maybe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we all done warming up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm ready to start whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We only have one week remaining, so we gotta make the most of every second we have left.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't go easy on us, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, I won't.
Get ready to cling on for dear life.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In one week's time, it's really happening.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It felt like we had plenty of time to prepare when we first chose that date...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I went to hear what the locals were saying yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The air was buzzing with anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Surpassing RAD WEEKEND meant having to get all our pieces on the board.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: An, you got the locals behind you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Kotaro, EVER...
You guys found the courage to get back on your feet.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And last but not least, Kohane, you unlocked your potential.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's now or never.
Things have reached a fever pitch, so this is your best chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We found people to staff our event too, so now we just gotta focus all our attention on the task at hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we really don't have a second to waste.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's start preparing like we mean it for next week. Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone was much more motivated than usual during practice today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There was a nice tension in the air. But I'm exhausted after singing for hours and hours.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still, I am feeling a lot better now as a result...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Miku.
What brings you here so late?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I know you must be tired.
But I wanted to talk to you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes.
It's one week from today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I guessed you might be feeling a little anxious, so I'm here to help you relax.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You really are incredible, Miku.
You saw right through me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't seem to stay still.
I mean, everything's coming to a head next week...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because you've never once run away from your feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She's right...
I was put to the test over and over along the way, but I'm standing here right now because I kept trying.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Go show them that you're just as passionate about what you're doing as we were.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, that takes care of An's task...
Which just leaves yours.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What's he going to ask me to do?
The others' tasks all sounded really hard.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, I'll only be telling you about one today. I'll tell you about the other after you've completed this one so that you can stay focused on the task at hand.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Now, for your first task, you'll need to...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm not talking about just polishing your skills.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to be powerful enough to blast a hole in the moment RAD WEEKEND became a legend.
